subject: general
question: Cyclone Amphan hit West Bengal in May, 2020. Where did the cyclone originate from?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bay of Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Super Cyclonic Storm Amphan **was a **powerful **and **catastrophic tropical cyclone **that caused **widespread damage **in **Eastern India**.
 
• **Specifically **in **West Bengal **and **Odisha**, and **in Bangladesh**, in **May 2020**.
 
• The **cyclone produced **sustained **winds **of **112 km/h **(70 mph) and **gusts **to **190 km/h **(120 mph)
 
• **Wind speed **along **coastal areas **was **measured **up to **150–160 km/h **(93–99 mph).
 
• The **causes of the Amphan cyclone **included the formation **of an area of low pressure **over the **Bay of Bengal **about **1020 km to the southeast of Visakhapatnam**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
